deviations_from_plan: exposeAt is generic in the observation observe : X × Tag → R instead of the decision D : X → Bool; the plan program is observe := decideTag D, for which observe <$> tag work index is decisionClient D work index. exposeAt takes identityIndex, publicIdentity, owners and state like KemEncapsulation.commands; rawScan instantiates them with the initialized Server like KemChallenge.pre.

rawCut_shape gives the saved continuation in the literal form rawResume (source suffix, accept tail, hidden rest of the tagged client); the KemOpaqueResume.resume_reply form needs lane port L2 (stage D). It additionally records that the raw bytes come from a reached pending AcceptCut cut.

accepted_reached is stated on the KEM cut: a completed cut has an outcome observe (result, tag) with accepted tag = false (the contrapositive reading of the plan sentence). Rejection after the hook gives accept reply none, hence accepted = false, by the definition of the tag; no separate statement is needed.

T3 is KemRawCertified.advantage for the proof-carrying adversary; KemRawGame.advantageRaw_error is the same bound for the plain adversary. εKEM is the definition KemRawGame.correctnessError, written with 𝒟[...] {true} because the VCVio revision deprecates probOutput and the Pr[= ...] notation.

The plan M8 post_bound is adversary_post, which uses the existing context-generic KemPostBills.post_bound; pre_bills are pre_uniform, pre_decapsulations and pre_base. M8 is split into KemRawCertified and KemRawBills (allowed by the plan).

Helper statements added and guarded: actual_hide, free_hide, support_simulate, commands_support, hide_free, scan_hide, before_callbacks, before_free, ordered_cut, ordered_complete, tail_none, exposeAt_scan, accept_scan, exposeAt_commands (M5); real_le_ideal (M7); hides_refl, hides_all, hides_bind, hides_bound, exposeAt_hides, exposeAt_bills, residual_hook, preRaw_bound, uniform_cap, scan_bills, pre_excluded, annotated_bound (M8).
No planned statement was false or unprovable; none was weakened, and no existing theorem was modified.
